input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including hold, book, catalog book. The platform provides capabilities for circulation desk, catalog management. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include e-commerce functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to create and manage hold records, so that I can track and organize hold data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage book records, so that I can track and organize book data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage catalog book records, so that I can track and organize catalog book data effectively.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to interact with circulation desk functionality, so that I can accomplish my circulation desk-related tasks.
